il_articles.titre: Monday open indicative forex prices, October 5, 2026
il_articles.contenu:
Summary

As is usual for a Monday morning, market liquidity is very thin until it improves as more Asian centres come online ... prices are liable to swing around, so take care out there.

Early FX indications, not much change from late Friday so far

EUR/USD 1.1257

USD/JPY 157.73

GBP/USD 1.3241

USD/CHF 0.8289

USD/CAD 1.4256

AUD/USD 0.6957 (ps. it's a partial holiday in Australia today, but the Australian Securities Exchange is open as normal)
